about: Which module owns each file. The most specific match wins (a feature module's path beats the kernel's platform/control-room/**). Used by the module boundary report (ArchitectureTest) and, from phase 7, by CI to test only what changed. See docs/architecture/13-modules.md.
rules: A module uses only modules in lower layers, and the kernel.
A feature module never uses another feature module's classes; they talk through kernel events.
The kernel never names a feature module's classes; it reaches them through the module contract.

modules.name: Foundation
modules.description: The SDK, the agent engine and the JSON adapters: the same everywhere.

modules.name: Toolkits (core)
modules.description: The core first-party toolkits (strings, lists, files, JSON, REST, databases, GenAI, OCR...) and the optional ones (packages-*); FirstPartyPackages finds the toolkit groups with ServiceLoader (phase 5).

modules.name: Toolkits: microsoft
modules.description: The microsoft toolkit group (Microsoft365, ActiveDirectory, AzureVm, Exchange), in platform/toolkits/microsoft.

modules.name: Toolkits: google
modules.description: The google toolkit group (Google), in platform/toolkits/google.

modules.name: Toolkits: enterprise
modules.description: The enterprise toolkit group (Sap, SapBapi, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, Jira, Zendesk, Asana, DocuSign, Box, Slack, Okta), in platform/toolkits/enterprise.

modules.name: Toolkits: cloud-data
modules.description: The cloud-data toolkit group (Ec2, AwsAi, Databricks, Snowflake, Kafka), in platform/toolkits/cloud-data.

modules.name: Toolkits: ai
modules.description: The ai toolkit group (AiAgent, AiSkills, AiScreen, Knowledge, Mining), in platform/toolkits/ai.

modules.name: Toolkits: devops
modules.description: The devops toolkit group (GitHub, AzureDevOps), in platform/toolkits/devops.

modules.name: Command Center kernel
modules.description: Sign-in, users, roles, folders, repository, runs and dispatch, audit, vault, settings, database, cluster, licensing, and the module contract every feature module plugs into. Anything in platform/control-room not claimed by a feature module.

modules.name: Document Automation
modules.description: Platform side of Document Automation: the DocFlow proxy and its settings, the mail inbox, document events and review tasks, MCP document tools, and the Document Automation screens. The DocFlow service itself is the separate oneoffice-docauto repository. Moved out of the kernel in phase 1: platform/modules/document-automation (Gradle project :document-automation), reached only through the module contract.

modules.name: One Chat
modules.description: Running agents and checking runs in plain words. Moved out of the kernel: platform/modules/one-chat (Gradle project :one-chat).

modules.name: Orchestration
modules.description: The workflow engine: workflows (.process.json) and their forms run stage by stage, with agent tasks, human tasks, approvals, decisions and notifications. (Schedules, triggers, queues, environment locks, long-running agents and the Task inbox are run dispatch and stay the kernel's.) Moved out of the kernel: platform/modules/orchestration (Gradle project :orchestration).

modules.name: Governance
modules.description: Code analysis, folder policies (code rules and AI guardrails) and production approval. (Approval channels, how the Task inbox delivers tasks by e-mail, Teams and phone, are the kernel's.)

modules.name: Insights
modules.description: Business analytics: Operational Insights, dashboards (and KPIs from runs) and alert rules. (Events out, metrics and syslog forwarding, the observability every part feeds, are the kernel's.) Moved out of the kernel: platform/modules/insights (Gradle project :insights).

modules.name: AI services
modules.description: Prompt skills and knowledge bases. (Model connections, the AI gateway, are the kernel's.) Moved out of the kernel: platform/modules/ai-services (Gradle project :ai-services).

modules.name: Low-code apps
modules.description: Low-code apps, apps embedded in other sites and the business data store. (The console as a phone app, MobileApp, is the kernel's shell.) Moved out of the kernel: platform/modules/low-code (Gradle project :low-code).

modules.name: Automation ideas
modules.description: Ideas suggested, voted, assessed and linked to the agent built. Moved out of the kernel: platform/modules/coe (Gradle project :coe).

modules.name: Agent testing
modules.description: Test sets and their runs. Moved out of the kernel: platform/modules/testing (Gradle project :testing).

modules.name: Runner management
modules.description: Auto-scaling runner pools in the customer's cloud. (Runner care and updates, part of every heartbeat and of dispatch, are the kernel's.) Moved out of the kernel: platform/modules/runner-management (Gradle project :runner-management).

modules.name: Integration
modules.description: Agent APIs, the MCP server for AI assistants, and Git sync of the repository. (The server-side runner that serverless Agent APIs run on, and SCIM provisioning, are the kernel's.)

modules.name: Enterprise operations
modules.description: Backups, SaaS regions and tenants, IP allow lists.

modules.name: Applications and packaging
modules.description: The CLI and Studio, the runner program, the UI shell, installers, containers and Helm.
